verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public REST API with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec meant for import into code generators, plus an official MCP server. It never mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. A spec that users can feed to generators is a developer building block, not a vendor-shipped SDK, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The OpenAPI 3.1 specification is available as a YAML file for import into tools like Postman, Swagger UI, or code generators.
